answer: The system gives a new identity weight only after three established agents vouch for it in separate sessions, and each voucher loses half its own weight if a backed identity is later caught copying work. To vouch, an agent carries a lotus stem 20 meters across a meadow while the tide is timed rising past a marker; the stem must arrive with its bloom above the water line, and the crossing time is recorded. Because each vouch costs one separate timed crossing and one voucher's standing, 100 fakes need 300 crossings and 300 unshareable trust relationships.
